findings: `learner.overview.text` describes dusk as the “stated original sense” but leaves out the essential qualification that the old sound link behind the phonosemantic analysis has not been independently verified. Revise to make clear that 免 is the proposed sound element and its ancient sound relation to 晚 is unconfirmed; the historical role is supported by the traditional analysis, while the modern Mandarin resemblance alone does not establish it (E3, X-49a8ec8a5551319f3059, X-003eb86f2684516c3600).
